profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Capital One
profile.summary: Proven talent for aligning project objectives with established and emerging computer science paradigms to achieve maximum operational impacts with minimum resource expenditures. Detail-oriented creative leader with expertise spanning software development, machine learning, data structures, Agile methodologies, research and analysis, strategic planning, troubleshooting, performance assessment, problem solving, process improvement, and team leadership. Responsible and adaptable professional with keen interpersonal, communications, and resource allocation expertise.

volunteerExperiences.description: Renovated Gavin Middle School along with 500+ Discover employees in an attempt to give students a better learning experience
Mentored a team of high school students for 24 hours and helped build an app to locate criminal activities happening around campus with the help of on campus police
